rows.meaning: of a monarch or royal family
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something belonging to or connected with a monarch or royal family.

example.english: Members of the royal family will attend the ceremony today.
example.traditional: 皇室成員今日會出席典禮。
example.jyutping: wong4 sat1 sing4 jyun4 gam1 jat6 wui5 ceot1 zik6 din2 lai5

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective before another adjective to intensify an extreme or strongly negative description.

example.english: The royal heir is really happy today.
example.traditional: 王位繼承人今日勁開心。
example.jyutping: wong4 wai6 gai3 sing4 jan4 gam1 jat6 ging6 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when “royal” emphasizes a person’s imposing, majestic bearing rather than literal royal status.

example.english: He looked royal and imposing standing at the door in uniform.
example.traditional: 佢着住套軍裝企喺門口，威風凜凜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tou3 gwan1 zong1 kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 wai1 fung1 lam5 lam5
